query: Generate Epics: read requirements/PRM_PNC_AppReview_Flows_User_Stories.md and break it down into implementation-ready stories for PNM.
expected_behavior: Reads the scope document before decomposing
Presents a decomposition plan (story boundaries per flow/component/persona) for user approval BEFORE generating the full stories
Limits to at most 10 stories per epic and asks to narrow scope if more would be needed
Generates each story in the canonical format with a concrete persona, Pattern A–D acceptance criteria in business language, and a Technical Implementation (high-level) section
Adds cross-references between dependent stories and produces a dependency-ordered summary
Verifies referenced components with code-review-graph and scans requirements/ for overlapping/conflicting existing stories
Each generated story includes Definition of done and Estimated Effort
